parameters.rng: python random.Random(seed), gauss draws in the order below

rules_in_arithmetic.estimate: est(r) = percentile(pool(r), p), linearly interpolated. pool(r) is the true debits of the UNDISCLOSED agents under the residual basis, and of ALL agents under the population basis.
rules_in_arithmetic.books: carried(r) = SUM over agents of (true_debit if disclosed else est(r))
rules_in_arithmetic.who_moves: an agent discloses in round r iff true_debit + cost < est(r)
rules_in_arithmetic.stop: when no agent moves, or after max_rounds

five_farm_demo.note: The whole mechanism on five farms with zero disclosure cost. No random numbers. Every row can be redone on paper.

how_to_check_this_without_running_it: The five-farm demo has no random numbers at all. It is the argument in full, and every round of it is on this page.
The 2000-agent fixture IS exported, in full, under `full_fixture_2000_agents`. Nothing about the main run is hidden behind a seed.

The stated limits of the sim are the sim's own, printed under READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING THE NUMBERS, and they still stand: market access is not modelled, agents are myopic, and the disclosure cost is a guess.
